curves.test_conditions: Tj = 25 degC; pulse width = 300 us; duty cycle = 1%; US5MC is included in the US5JC-US5MC dotted curve family

datasheet_identity.title: US5AC THRU US5MC SURFACE MOUNT HIGH EFFICIENT RECTIFIER

extraction_notes: Forward-voltage curve points are approximate digitizations of the US5JC-US5MC dotted trace in Fig. 3; no interpolation beyond the plotted readings was used.

The datasheet publishes VRRM/VDC = 1000 V ratings for US5MC but no breakdown-voltage test row, so breakdown_voltage and breakdown_current are omitted rather than treating a blocking rating as measured breakdown.
The 100 degC reverse-current row is 200 uA and was not used for the 25 degC reverse_current field.
omission_reason: No breakdown-voltage or breakdown-current test point is published; only reverse-blocking ratings are provided.
